# connectracer_connect_hours_of_operation_override (Resource)

Replaces the weekly schedule of an hours of operation for a date range, such as a Christmas closure or longer opening hours before a holiday.

During the range only the days in `config` are open. Without `config` the hours of operation are closed for the whole range. A flow sees which override applied in `$.HoursOfOperation.AppliedOverride` after a *Check hours of operation* block with *Check override* enabled.

The resource creates a one-off override (`STANDARD`). Recurring overrides are not supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Closed over Christmas: without config the whole range is closed.
resource "connectracer_connect_hours_of_operation_override" "christmas" {
  instance_id           = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
  hours_of_operation_id = aws_connect_hours_of_operation.support.hours_of_operation_id
  name                  = "Christmas"
  effective_from        = "2026-12-24"
  effective_till        = "2026-12-26"
}

# Shorter hours on New Year's Eve: only the listed days are open during the range.
resource "connectracer_connect_hours_of_operation_override" "new_years_eve" {
  instance_id           = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
  hours_of_operation_id = aws_connect_hours_of_operation.support.hours_of_operation_id
  name                  = "New Year's Eve"
  description           = "Open until noon"
  effective_from        = "2026-12-31"
  effective_till        = "2026-12-31"

  config = [
    {
      day        = "THURSDAY"
      start_time = { hours = 8, minutes = 0 }
      end_time   = { hours = 12, minutes = 0 }
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `effective_from` (String) The first day of the range, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `effective_till` (String) The last day of the range, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `hours_of_operation_id` (String) The identifier of the hours of operation the override belongs to.
- `instance_id` (String) The identifier of the Amazon Connect instance.
- `name` (String) The name of the override, which a flow compares `$.HoursOfOperation.AppliedOverride` with.

### Optional

- `config` (Attributes Set) The opening hours per day during the range. Omit it to close the whole range. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `description` (String) The description of the override.

### Read-Only

- `hours_of_operation_override_id` (String) The identifier of the override.
- `id` (String) The composite identifier (`instance_id/hours_of_operation_id/hours_of_operation_override_id`).

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Required:

- `day` (String) The day of the week, e.g. `MONDAY`.
- `end_time` (Attributes) When the contact center closes on that day. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--end_time))
- `start_time` (Attributes) When the contact center opens on that day. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--start_time))

<a id="nestedatt--config--end_time"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.end_time`

Required:

- `hours` (Number) The hour, 0 to 23.
- `minutes` (Number) The minute, 0 to 59.


<a id="nestedatt--config--start_time"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.start_time`

Required:

- `hours` (Number) The hour, 0 to 23.
- `minutes` (Number) The minute, 0 to 59.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is instance_id/hours_of_operation_id/hours_of_operation_override_id.
terraform import connectracer_connect_hours_of_operation_override.christmas \
  "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012/abcdef12-3456-7890-abcd-ef1234567890/fedcba98-7654-3210-fedc-ba9876543210"
```
